Professional summary

Analytical AI/ML Engineer (B.Tech in Artificial Intelligence and Data Science, CGPA 8.7, Batch Topper) with 1+ year of hands-on experience turning data and AI into working digital solutions, from prototype to production. Combines analytical insight (EDA, hypothesis testing, segmentation, model evaluation) with a strong passion for technology: software development (Python, FastAPI, React, SQL), IT architecture and infrastructure (REST APIs, JWT, Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD with GitHub Actions) and security-first engineering (PII redaction, safety thresholds, guardrails, prompt-injection detection). Built digital products end to end, including a flight booking platform and a multi-agent recruitment platform, and generative AI solutions (LLMs, RAG, FAISS) with the OpenAI, Claude and Gemini APIs. Published researcher (ICST Conference 2025), collaborative across technical and non-technical stakeholders, with clear written documentation, and based in Dubai for in-person work.

Work experience

AI Developer · PixDynamics, Kochi, India
June 2025 – August 2026 · part-time during college, then full-time
  • Delivered AI solutions from prototype to production: built and deployed end-to-end computer vision pipelines (ingestion, YOLO-based object detection, redaction, API response) for document-processing and PII-redaction use cases.
  • Engineered AI inference backends with Python and FastAPI, serving model predictions through JWT-secured REST APIs integrated into production-oriented workflows.
  • Led data quality and analysis: verified and prepared ~8,000 document images, built structured train/validation datasets, and used ROC curves, precision/recall, confusion-matrix review and error analysis of misdetections to drive improvements.
  • Applied AI security, privacy and governance controls: set and calibrated safety thresholds for a privacy-critical use case, prioritising recall so sensitive data does not slip through (a guardrail trade-off against over-masking).
  • Worked in Agile sprints with Git and Docker, shipping authenticated, sensitive-data-aware systems and documenting work clearly for team members.
Data Science Intern · Outrix, Remote
June 2025 – July 2025
  • Performed exploratory data analysis and preprocessing on 1,000 student performance records (cleaning, missing values, outliers, encoding, scaling) and applied hypothesis testing and correlation analysis, turning findings into actionable patterns.
  • Built a K-Means customer segmentation model, profiling each cluster into actionable insights, and a TF-IDF and cosine-similarity recommendation engine using Python, Pandas, NumPy and SciPy.
